Van Gogh Painting Sells for Record $190.4 Million at Auction

Vincent van Gogh's painting 'Chataigniers en Fleurs' was sold at auction for a record $190.4 million. The sale at Sotheby's occurred after an 11th-hour settlement. The painting has a complex past.
